subject: SOW redlines: carveout-to-pilot conversion and pricing swap
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sat, 9 May 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: SOW redlines: carveout-to-pilot conversion and pricing swap

Hi team,

Quick summary: ClearBridge wants us to accept a contractual carveout that allows a "pilot -> production" conversion with two specific asks:

- Ability to convert pilot capacity to production capacity without a full reprocurement, with a 30-day notice and defined acceptance criteria.
- A temporary pricing swap for the first 90 days post-conversion — move from committed-rate to pay-as-you-go at a capped per-token rate (they asked for a not-to-exceed).

Attached: SOW_v2_clean.docx (proposed by sales) — it includes the carveout language I drafted but it's intentionally high level. They also flagged a need for a small data-residency exhibit in case the pilot ingests PHI-adjacent data.

Ask: Laura — can you review the attached SOW and advise on:
1) Whether the carveout language as drafted exposes us to any operational or billing risk (automatic conversion vs. signed order form).
2) Suggested guardrails for a 30/60/90 day conversion window, rollback rights, and how to express the pricing swap (cap vs. firm rate).
3) Any DPA/KMS linkage we should require in the SOW or order form.

Karthik/Connor — please confirm commercial tradeoffs (we may need to offer a modest initial discount to get the conversion clause). I want to get legal language back to ClearBridge before Monday.

Thanks,

Irene Choi
Sr. Manager, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_v2_clean.docx (docx)

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@clearbridge.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Torres <sam.torres@clearbridge.ai>, Legal Ops <legal@clearbridge.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOW redlines: carveout-to-pilot conversion and pricing swap

Thanks Irene — attaching our redline and a short note on priorities.

Priority items from our side:
- Pilot-to-production conversion: we need a defined conversion trigger (acceptance criteria with objective tests) and a path that avoids another full RFP for the first 6 months after a successful pilot.
- Pricing: we expect a temporary PAYG rate for the first 90 days after conversion capped at $0.0008/token, while we validate scale.
- Data residency: during pilot, data must remain in US-east and be isolated per project; add an exhibit to the SOW for regional handling.
- Compliance: proof of SOC 2 Type II and an initial security questionnaire answer set.

We attached: redlines_SOW_v2.pdf (redlined SOW) and a short evidence packet (SOC2_summary.pdf). Let us know if you need us to sign a limited addendum now while legal finalizes the order form language.

Laura / Irene — quick commercial/legal thinking after reading ClearBridge's redlines:

- I agree on making the conversion explicit but gated. Proposal: add a Pilot Acceptance Appendix that lists 3 objective tests (latency SLA, throughput for a 24-hr steady-state test, and accuracy threshold on a validation set) plus a 14-day acceptance notice window. Conversion would be executed by a signed Change Order referencing the existing Order Form, not automatically.

- Pricing swap: ok to allow PAYG capped at $0.0008/token for 90 days, but we should include a minimum monthly committed spend during that 90-day window (small nominal) to mitigate churn risk.

- Data residency: we can provide a one-page Exhibit D for regional handling; engineering needs to confirm feasibility for US-east isolation (Connor, can you confirm within EOD Monday?).

- Billing/ops: attach draft OrderForm_draft.xlsx with fields for conversion date, cap rate, and minimum spend. If legal is comfortable, we can return a tracked SOW with these three options for ClearBridge to pick.

Laura — can you draft two short paragraphs (one for the SOW appendix and one for the change order template) that cover rollback and liability limits? If we can get that back by Monday I will coordinate commercial acceptance.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference

Attachment: OrderForm_draft.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SOW redlines: carveout-to-pilot conversion and pricing swap

Thanks — reviewed the redlines and proposed approach. High-level guidance and next steps below.

Summary of legal position (short):
1) Pilot Conversion Mechanics — Acceptable with conditions. We should require:
   - A written Change Order signed by both parties to effect conversion (do not allow automatic conversion).
   - A Pilot Acceptance Appendix with objective acceptance tests (we can draft example language).
   - A 14-day remediation window post-acceptance for critical issues, with a limited rollback right if acceptance tests materially fail.

2) Pricing Swap — Recommended structure:
   - Allow PAYG capped at $0.0008/token for 90 days post-conversion, contingent on a minimum monthly commitment of $10k during that period.
   - Include a cap on total exposure (not-to-exceed liability) tied to the minimum commitment + 3x expected monthly spend; this protects us against runaway pilot usage.

3) Data Residency & Compliance — Add Exhibit D (Data Residency) and reference SOC 2 evidence in the SOW. We should attach SOC2_summary.pdf to the legal response and note that any PHI ingestion requires additional DPA terms (flagging to security).

Action items and timeline:
- I will produce a tracked legal response (redlines_response_legal.docx) with three options:
  A) Standard Change Order + Appendix (recommended)
  B) Temporary addendum with automatic conversion language (higher risk)
  C) Pilot extension path (if they decline conversion)
- Draft will include suggested wording for rollback, acceptance tests, and pricing cap.
- Will share the tracked document by EOD Monday (2026-05-11 18:00 PT).

If you want, I can hop on a 30-minute sync with ClearBridge legal to talk through the options Tuesday morning.

Laura Bennett
Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redlines_response_legal.docx (docx)
